_comment: Run provenance for the published benchmark figures. Sources: Kaggle kernel lastRunTime via `kaggle kernels list --user larachiefofstaff --csv` (authoritative server-side run time), and the captured results.json for each run. Future runs stamp their own timestamps into results.json via run_provenance; the three Kaggle datasets below predate that change and are dated from the Kaggle API instead.
method: Kaggle API lastRunTime (UTC), converted to AEST (UTC+10, Brisbane, no DST).
